scientific_context: NASA/JPL space fabric is metallic and foldable, not equivalent to printed PLA or validated body armor.
Growth near the air/liquid interface may bridge chainmail joints; this might increase stiffness but remove flexibility.
No scientific claim about useful reinforcement until comparison with PLA-only and post-assembly controls.
A PLA/BC tensile result from a differently prepared composite is not a measured result of living-SCOBY growth.

surrogate_model.description: Toy 1D parallel tensile-load path and bending-stiffness upper-bound proxy; unknown q,b joint engagement parameters. Neither calibrated, validated FEM, nor actual geometry-dependent calculation.
surrogate_model.q_and_b_semantics: q and b are arbitrary illustrative coefficients in [0,1], not probabilities or empirically identified parameters. q=effective tensile load engagement; b=effective bending lock-up

sweep.computation: Reproduce 36 grid combinations using linked simulator

surrogate_model.conclusion: For the illustrative inputs, increased participation of PLA increases tensile-stiffness proxy and locked PLA joints increase bending-stiffness proxy. This does not show which design performs better physically.

physical_plan.goal: Investigate BC intergrowth of print-in-place PLA chainmail while preserving joint mobility
physical_plan.material: plain unfilled PLA; phosphor Glow PLA excluded from wet culture
physical_plan.geometry: Measure exact STL scale, projected link coverage, open fraction and free joint mobility before physical printing. Nominal dimensions not validated.

growth_conditions.name: BC grown with rigid PLA grid in glass
BC grown with mobile linked PLA NASA fabric in glass

mechanical_controls.name: Separately grown BC loosely assembled over PLA NASA fabric

physical_plan.repetitions: At least 3 independent culture vessels per growth condition after pilot. Technical cuts from one pellicle are not independent culture replicates.
confound_controls: Identical feed batch and initial inoculum provenance
equal air-liquid interface and liquid depth
same area and growth observation period
matched PLA mass/contact area when comparing grid to chainmail
no new UV light/Glow chemicals in culture
culture_endpoints: pellicle appearance and thickness by day
physical_endpoints: tensile strength and strain at break with matched geometry
separate isolated SkinGPT v0.3 signal and calibration
physical_plan.acceptance: Only independent repeatable physical observations can establish any benefit; growth and mechanical claims must have separate controls.
physical_plan.safety: Non-food culture only; do not ingest or recycle into kombucha. No bare sensor wiring in wet culture. No ballistic or protective performance claims without relevant accredited testing.
